# Parse the CSV data properly, stripping \r characters
lines = csv_content.replace('\r', '').strip().split('\n')
headers = [h.strip() for h in lines[0].split(',')]
print(f"Columns: {headers}")

won_deals = []
total_won = 0.0

for line in lines[1:]:
    fields = [f.strip() for f in line.split(',')]
    row = {headers[j]: fields[j] for j in range(len(headers))}
    
    if row['status'].lower() == 'won':
        amount = float(row['amount'])
        total_won += amount
        won_deals.append(row)

# Print summary
print(f"\nTotal deals in file: {len(lines) - 1}")
print(f"Won deals: {len(won_deals)}")
print(f"\nWon deal details:")
for d in won_deals:
    print(f"  {d['deal_id']} | {d['rep_name']:20s} | {d['region']:6s} | {d['product']:25s} | ${float(d['amount']):>10,.2f} | {d['close_date']}")

print(f"\n{'='*90}")
print(f"TOTAL NEW CONTRACT VALUE (Meridian Analytics - Won Deals): ${total_won:,.2f}")
